physics: velocity_servo_v1; pose plus zero velocity per physics step; magnetic, not contact grasp
runner: python3 setup/94_scenario_runner.py --stage baseline --policy <arm> --smoke-summary <passing-summary.jsonl> --seed 20260930 --batch S1:50 S2:100 S3:50 S4:50 S5:50 S7:100
dry_run: python3 setup/94_scenario_runner.py --dry-run --seed 20260930 --batch S1:50 S2:100 S3:50 S4:50 S5:50 S7:100
entry_requirements: five passing smoke runs per requested cell, same policy/protocol/runtime fingerprint; baseline flag required
reset exits 0 with ok:true (signals/timeouts are harness errors)
each result matches a fresh episode by evidence_id
decision latency is measured with perf_counter_ns
model arms have configured endpoints and report actual routing provenance
S2 injection targets A only; S3 injection targets B only
interpretation: Targets reduce uncertainty; n=50/100 alone does not guarantee power for a chosen effect size. S4/S5 expect typed failure, so expectation-match rate differs from task success rate. S6 remains a lifecycle/cold-start test.
cohort_rule: Never pool the initial, engage and final readiness deployment fingerprints, or the old teleport baseline.
remaining_before_large_batch: Five passing runs in each requested cell under one identical deployed fingerprint
Resolve or explicitly bound task policy rejection and service discovery failures; model replay remains NOT_RUN
